artifacts.summary: Confirms the audit's five findings against live source files and maps scope items A-E to exact edit anchors: new standards/semantic-element-usage.md, rem: row + semantics pointer in patterns/theorem-environments.md, a positive theorem-then-remark example in templates/chapter-template.md, a sibling-shaped index-entries.json entry, and structural self-review MUST NOT items in both agents/typst-implementation-agent.md (Stage 4C, Critical Requirements) and skills/skill-typst-implementation/SKILL.md (covering the Stage 5b self-execution fallback path).

memory_candidates.content: In the typst extension, context/project/typst/patterns/*.md files hold mechanics only (how to invoke thmbox environments, rule-block/rule-list); context/project/typst/standards/*.md files hold governance/semantics (what an element is for, density, placement norms). When a pattern file needs a 'why/when' rule, add it to a standards/ file and cross-reference from the pattern file, rather than embedding prose norms directly in patterns/.

A checklist bullet in a template/standards file that no verification gate ever reads does not change agent behavior, even when the file is correctly wired into index-entries.json load_when.agents. Observed directly: chapter-template.md's 'Opening paragraph explaining chapter purpose' checklist item was violated by a real generated document despite being loaded into the implementation agent's context. Structural norms need an explicit self-review step inside a Stage (e.g. 'before marking verification complete, re-check X against standard Y') to have enforcement teeth, not just a MUST NOT list entry or checklist line.

A skill's Stage 5b self-execution fallback (per skill-self-execution-fallback.md) can bypass an implementation agent's own Stage-level verification entirely, because in that path the skill's own execution context authors files directly without ever invoking the subagent. Any structural/content gate added to an implementation agent's contract must also be mirrored (or cross-referenced) in the wrapping SKILL.md itself, or the fallback path silently skips the gate.
